neighbours.label: 'with' or 'by' introducing the means that delivers an experience in promotional or lifestyle copy
fire: Treat yourself this summer and refresh your skin with our new cucumber mist.
The resort pampers its guests by offering free massages every afternoon.
Take your morning coffee to the next level with a splash of vanilla cream.
The loft keeps its industrial charm with exposed brick and steel beams.
Our new menu celebrates the season by featuring local berries in every dessert.
Bring a touch of the tropics into your home with these bright cushions.
The hotel welcomes families by providing a free kids' club all week.
Kick off the weekend in style with our handcrafted cocktails.

notes: Card peaks on ' with' / ' by' / ',' in marketing copy ('to a new level with', 'caters to ... by providing').
